title: Get Out Of Your Own Way

questions.q: What did Dave Hollis do after succeeding as head of sales at Disney?
a: He quit to work in his wife's business
He asked for a bigger promotion
He started his own film studio
He retired early to travel
questions.why: The overview says he was successful but miserable, so he left despite what everyone expected.

questions.q: What did his son Jackson's class president run teach Dave?
a: Losing does not make you a failure
Politics is not worth the effort
Practice guarantees a win
Parents should choose their children's goals
questions.why: The first lesson says Dave had failed at the same dream twice, so he could show his son that defeat is survivable.

a: Believing your skills and talents cannot change
Believing effort always pays off
Believing talent is passed down in families
Believing failure is only temporary
questions.why: The first lesson says a growth mindset means knowing you can change anything about yourself.

questions.q: What did the Hollises' adoption struggle illustrate?
a: Pushing through pain can be worth it
Adoption agencies are usually unreliable
Luck matters more than effort
Some goals should be abandoned early
questions.why: The second lesson says they kept going after losing the twins and eventually adopted a daughter.

a: A false story about yourself that you accept as fact
A rule imposed on you by your family
A fear based on clear evidence
A goal that is simply too ambitious
questions.why: The third lesson says such beliefs put invisible fences around what you are capable of.
